notes.title: ANGST Dev Update
notes.notes:
Hey Survivors,

First off, sorry for the radio silence, we’ve been deep in the frost, quietly working away on Angst, and we’re finally coming up for air.

The good news? 
Development is very much alive, and we’re pushing hard to make this the best version of Angst yet.

We also have a little spoiler to drop:
Base building is coming.
Yep, we’ve decided to bring this feature into the game. It’s still early, but we’re building out systems that will let you carve out a bit of safety in the cold, hostile world - and defend it.

Alongside that, we’re adding other cool features, which we’ll be sharing more about soon. Expect updates with more detail and some fresh visuals in the near future.

Thanks for sticking with us. We’re still here, still building, and still committed to delivering something special.


Stay warm, stay sharp - survival is still not guaranteed.

- The Cherrypick Games Team

notes.title: ANGST Dev Update
notes.notes:
Hey Survivors!

We’ve been in development, making tweaks and improvements to Angst, and we wanted to share a quick update. Thanks to all of you who participated in our playtests and community discussions—your feedback has been invaluable! We’ve been listening carefully and are working hard to refine the game based on your insights.

:fire: What’s On?

Survival Mechanics Overhaul – We’re doubling down on deepening survival elements while keeping them accessible and engaging. Every decision will matter.

Combat Adjustments – Encounters are being fine-tuned to feel more intense and rewarding. Every fight should be a battle for survival, not just a formality... also, new enemy types are now lurking in the frozen dark!

Base Building? Maybe! – Many of you have asked about this, and we’re exploring ways to implement a meaningful, strategic base-building element.

A Bit Revised Art Direction – We’re experimenting with some tweaks to the visual style to enhance the overall atmosphere and make Angst even more immersive.

Story – Peeling Back the Layers

While ANGST is, at its core, a survival experience, we always envisioned it as something more—a story that unfolds as you endure. With that in mind, we’ve been layering in new narrative elements to heighten immersion and mystery.

Your feedback has played a huge role in shaping these changes, and we’re committed to making Angst the best experience possible.

Stay safe out there—survival is never guaranteed...

— The Cherrypick Games Team

notes.title: Developer's Update: ANGST – Open Single Player Playtest
notes.notes:
Hey survivors,
Angst is now available for open playtest of the single player mode! We also invite everyone to sign up for our Discord and tell us what you think. We want to gather as much feedback to make the best game possible.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=wl3JsRNdOx0

Key Inspirations and Features of the full game:

When we started developing ANGST, our goal was to go beyond traditional survival mechanics. Here’s what we focused on: 
Survival with dynamic challenges: Each narrative plot introduces new quests and challenges. Learn, adapt, and venture deeper into the wild to uncover the mystery behind the Angst.

Dynamic multiplayer environments: Procedurally generated worlds with harsh biomes that shift and evolve as you play, making every co-op mission unique.


Death as part of progress: Each death reveals more about the world’s rules and brings you closer to understanding the Angst and the story behind it.
 

Emotional depth: More than just survival—experience the psychological struggles of isolation, fear, and uncertainty. Redemption awaits as guilt, sorrow, and helplessness pull you deeper into limbo.


Mysterious entities: Encounter strange beings—some will help, others will hinder—adding layers of tension and mystery to your journey.

What’s Next:
As we approach the next stage of development, we’re hard at work refining the core systems and mechanics that make ANGST so compelling. And now, we’re inviting YOU to join the open Single Player Playtest starting October 14th on Steam!

Here’s how you can be part of the journey:

Single Player Playtest the game starting October 14th: Get early access to explore ANGST and provide valuable feedback on the game’s mechanics and overall experience.


Wishlist on Steam and join our Discord: Stay up to date on news and updates as we approach the full launch.


Thanks again for joining us on this journey!
The Cherrypick Games Team
